ROW.COLUMN: (FR/CU) Escalation in ATM Activity: Withdrawals to Daily Limit

A sudden surge in ATM withdrawals close to the daily limit by customers may be suspicious and potentially fraudulent which may warrant additional investigation. This scenario detects sudden surge in ATM withdrawals close to the daily limit by customers during a short period of time.
Escl in ATM Act: W/D to Daily Limit

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

ACTVTY_RISK_LVL, C.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB EFCTV_RISK_LVL, C.MAX_DAILY_ATM_WDRWL_AM MAX_DAILY_ATM_WDRWL_AM, min(A.ACCT_OPEN_DT) OVER (partition by C.CUST_INTRL_ID) ACCT_OPEN_DT, count (distinct A.ACCT_INTRL_ID) OVER (partition by C.CUST_INTRL_ID) ACCT_CNT, CT.TRXN_BASE_AM as Tot_Debit_Amt, (case when CT.TRXN_BASE_AM - trunc(CT.TRXN_BASE_AM,-@Lrf_Digits) = 0 then CT.TRXN_BASE_AM when inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST C on A.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID=C.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only CT.DBT_CDT_CD='D' and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' --Include and C.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- Exclude Cancelled transactions and CT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null --All Jurisdictions, Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y' or C.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incld_Jurisdictions_Lst)) --To include MANTAS_TEST59_1 BUSINESS_TEST59_1 Acct Types and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@MANTAS_Bus_Acct_Typ_Lst) --All Transaction Source, Included Transaction Souce Codes and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' or CT.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incld_Trans_Src_Lst)) --LookBack Period + Current Day Period days Tunable and CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = (@LookBack_Period+(@Current_Period-1))) and CT.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and CT.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = (@LookBack_Period+(@Current_Period-1))) ), CustBkt as ( --Get only those customer records which are returned from primary query select MQ.CUST_INTRL_ID, MQ.CUST_SEQ_ID, KCQ.CLNDR_DT, max(MQ.ACCT_CNT) ACCT_CNT, max(MQ.Actvty_Risk_Lvl) ACTVTY_RISK_LVL, max(MQ.Efctv_Risk_Lvl) EFCTV_RISK_LVL, max(MQ.MAX_DAILY_ATM_WDRWL_AM) MAX_DAILY_ATM_WDRWL_AM, sum(case when MQ.TRXN_EXCTN_DT= KCQ.CLNDR_DT then MQ.Tot_Debit_Amt else 0 end) DLY_TRXN, sum(case when MQ.TRXN_EXCTN_DT= KCQ.CLNDR_DT then MQ.LRF_AM else 0 end) LRF_AM from MainQry MQ, --cross join with kdd_cal table to get all the days within the lookback period (select KC.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC -- LookBack Period days Tunable where KC.CLNDR_DT <= (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and KC.CLNDR_DT > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = (@LookBack_Period+(@Current_Period-1))) )KCQ group by MQ.CUST_INTRL_ID, MQ.CUST_SEQ_ID, KCQ.CLNDR_DT having -- Frequency Period check atleast 1 ATM withdrawal should happen on current date max(MQ.TRXN_EXCTN_DT) = (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) -- Exclude new customer accounts with Min_Open_Days filter and (min(ACCT_OPEN_DT) is null or min(ACCT_OPEN_DT) <= (select add_days(B.CLNDR_DT,-@Min_Open_Days) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) ) ), FinQry as ( --Query to select all records with Moving Average Amounts CBR.CUST_INTRL_ID order by CBR.CLNDR_DT rows (@Current_Period-1) preceding) /@Current_Period MVG_AVG_AMT, CBR.LRF_AM from CustBkt CBR ), Cur_Day_Calc as ( --Query to select records only for current period calculations select CUST_INTRL_ID, CUST_SEQ_ID, stddev_samp(MVG_AVG_AMT) CUR_STD_VAL, sum(DLY_TRXN)/@Current_Period CUR_AVG_VAL, sum(DLY_TRXN) CURR_TRXN_AMT, sum(LRF_AM) LRF_AM from FinQry CDC where CDC.CLNDR_DT <= (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and CDC.CLNDR_DT > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where CUST_INTRL_ID, CUST_SEQ_ID, max(ACCT_CNT) ACCT_CNT, max(MAX_DAILY_ATM_WDRWL_AM) MAX_DAILY_ATM_WDRWL_AM, max(MVG_AVG_AMT) PRIOR_PEAK_VAL, stddev_samp(MVG_AVG_AMT) PRIOR_STD_VAL, avg(MVG_AVG_AMT) PRIOR_AVG_VAL, sum(DLY_TRXN) PRIOR_TRXN_AMT from FinQry PPC where --prior period is Day1 to current day -1 PPC.CLNDR_DT < (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and PPC.CLNDR_DT > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @LookBack_Period) --Include Days with No Activity Filter as ( select CUST_INTRL_ID, CUST_SEQ_ID, max(ACTVTY_RISK_LVL) ACTVTY_RISK_LVL, max(EFCTV_RISK_LVL) EFCTV_RISK_LVL, (case when max(ORC.EFCTV_RISK_LVL)>= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and
